metadata.title: Echoes of the Void
metadata.description: A lone guardian must traverse a shattered cosmic realm to reclaim a stolen star before the silence consumes everything. Time is your only ally as ancient shadows rise from the dust of forgotten stars.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1_observance.name: The Waking Silence
act_1_observance.description: The protagonist awakens in the debris field, confused and alone, beginning to gather information about their surroundings.

scene_1_awakening.name: Debris Field Awakening
scene_1_awakening.description: You open your eyes to a silent expanse of floating metal and rock.

scene_2_wisp_encounter.name: The Fading Light
scene_2_wisp_encounter.description: A small, translucent entity drifts into view, offering cryptic warnings.

obj_1_calibrate.description: Calibrate the Void Compass to stabilize your position.

act_2_engagement.name: Descent into the Relic
act_2_engagement.description: The environment reacts to your presence, forcing an active confrontation with the remnants of the ship and the planet's core.

scene_3_archivist.name: The Last Log
scene_3_archivist.description: You access a dormant terminal where an AI archivist fragments its memory.

scene_4_relic.name: The Core Chamber
scene_4_relic.description: A massive mechanical heart pulses weakly, guarded by unstable energy.

obj_2_retrieve.description: Retrieve the essence vial from the core chamber using the star dust.

act_3_transcendence.name: The Final Sacrifice
act_3_transcendence.description: With the essence secured, you prepare to merge your consciousness with the dying star to save the universe.

scene_5_preparation.name: Channeling the Light
scene_5_preparation.description: You combine the essence vial with the relic's core, feeling your physical form destabilize.

scene_6_merge.name: Becoming the Dawn
scene_6_merge.description: Your consciousness flows into the star, creating a blinding new dawn.

obj_3_merge.description: Initiate the final transfer of consciousness into the star.

act_3_transcendence.ending_narration: The darkness recedes as your consciousness expands, knitting the fabric of reality back together. In the silence of the void, a new day begins, born from the last breath of the traveler who became the light.

npc_archivist.name: Unit 734

persona.voice: Monotone, data-dense, occasionally glitching with emotional resonance
motives: Understand the cause of the Void

knows: Location of the Void's breach point
can_reveal: The frequency needed to wake the Heart
A map of the debris field

npc_relic.name: Commander Vex

persona.voice: Gravelly, commanding, haunted by past failures
motives: Find a way to save the fleet
fears: Repeating the mistake of the last commander

knows: The physical toll of Void exposure
Location of the Heart's core stabilizer
can_reveal: How to survive the Heart's ignition
The cost of the final sacrifice

npc_wisp.name: Echo-9

persona.voice: Whispery, shifting between gender, fading in and out

knows: The emotional state of the Heart
The path of least resistance through the debris

item_star_dust.name: Stardust Fragment
item_star_dust.description: A glowing shard of crystallized starlight that hums when near the Heart.

item_void_compass.name: Void Compass
item_void_compass.description: A magnetic device that points not North, but toward the source of the Void's energy.

item_essence_vial.name: Void Essence Vial
item_essence_vial.description: Contains a captured drop of the ambient darkness; useful for shielding or binding.

item_memory_drive.name: Memory Drive
item_memory_drive.description: A ruggedized drive containing the last logs of the original crew.

skill_resonance.name: Void Resonance
skill_resonance.description: Allows the player to detect energy fluctuations in the debris field and synchronize with the Heart's rhythm.

skill_form_shift.name: Form Shift
skill_form_shift.description: Temporarily alters the player's physical composition to survive extreme heat or cold, at a mental cost.
